fusions.name: Kingfisher Plunge
fusions.desc: Dives you bill-first onto a target up to 7 tiles away for 13 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Quill Flight
fusions.desc: Looses 3 quills in a tight spread, each dealing 6 damage. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hung on the Air
fusions.desc: You dart 2 tiles from where you stood, and your movement speed rises by 30% for 6 seconds. You have 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Rattle on Deadwood
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
